## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Penetrating the Transformations of the Yì Diagrams*

by [雷思齊](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9B%B7%E6%80%9D%E9%BD%8A) (Léi Sīqí) — "Kōng shān xiān sheng"

Léi Sīqí's five-*juàn* **cosmological-diagrammatic treatise on the *Yì jīng***, dated 1330 by preface. Companion-work to [KR5d0031](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5d/KR5d0031) *Yì shì tōng biàn*. Preserved as **DZ 1014** / CT 1014 (Tài xuán bù 太玄部), with prefatory pieces [KR5d0032](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5d/KR5d0032) and [KR5d0033](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5d/KR5d0033).

**Dating.** 1330. Dynasty: 元.
